title: Moonmerge
tagline: Swipe to merge dust into pebbles, moons, planets and stars. A calm, quick sliding merge puzzle.
hint: Swipe or use arrow keys. Equal bodies merge into the next size.
tags: puzzle, merge, 2048, space, casual, relaxing, singleplayer, mobile-friendly, no-ads
goal: Merge matching bodies into bigger ones. Can you reach a Galaxy?
steps: Swipe (or use the arrow keys) to slide every body on the board in that direction.
When two bodies of the same size touch, they merge into the next size: Dust, Pebble, Rock, Moonlet, Moon, Dwarf planet, Planet, Gas giant, Star, Nova, Galaxy.
Each merge scores points, and a new body appears after every move.
If the board is full and nothing can merge, it collapses and the run ends.
tip: Keep your biggest body in a corner and build next to it.
